maintenance.title: Database Maintenance
maintenance.subtitle: Run VACUUM, ANALYZE and REINDEX with a preview and confirmation
maintenance.scopeHint: Enter schema and table together; leave both empty to run {command} on the whole database.
maintenance.reindexHint: Schema is required. Enter either a table or an index, not both.

hints.full: Takes ACCESS EXCLUSIVE LOCK; reclaims space but locks the table
hints.concurrently: Rebuilds the index without locking the table (recommended)

errors.scopePair: Enter schema and table together, or leave both empty.
errors.reindexScope: REINDEX needs a schema plus either a table or an index, not both.

toast.noDryRun: The dry run returned no result

confirm.title: Run {command}?
confirm.vacuum: Runs a standard VACUUM. It does not lock the table but can generate heavy I/O.
confirm.vacuumFull: Runs VACUUM FULL. It locks the table with ACCESS EXCLUSIVE LOCK and generates heavy I/O. Run it during low traffic.
confirm.analyze: Updates table statistics so the query planner can make better decisions. Does not block reads or writes.
confirm.reindex: Runs a standard REINDEX. Writes to the table are blocked until it finishes.
confirm.reindexConcurrent: Runs REINDEX CONCURRENTLY. It does not block writes but takes longer and adds CPU and I/O load.

notes.vacuum: Standard VACUUM runs without locking the table.
notes.vacuumFull: This takes ACCESS EXCLUSIVE LOCK. Run it during low traffic.
notes.analyze: ANALYZE does not block reads or writes and helps the query planner.
notes.reindex: Standard REINDEX blocks writes until it finishes.
notes.reindexConcurrent: CONCURRENTLY does not block writes but takes longer.

preview.title: SQL preview
preview.empty: Set the options and run a dry run. Changing an option requires a new preview.

table.title: Table maintenance status
table.subtitle: Dead tuple ratio with VACUUM and ANALYZE history
table.emptyHint: This database has no tables yet.

batch.targetsHint: VACUUM runs on the selected tables. FULL / ANALYZE / FREEZE come from the VACUUM tab.
batch.noSelection: Select at least one table from the list first.
batch.confirmDesc: VACUUM will be applied to the selected tables in order.
batch.confirmDescFull: VACUUM FULL will be applied to the selected tables. Each table takes an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE LOCK; run it during low traffic.
batch.resultsHint: Tables processed and their command results

backups.title: Backup and Restore
backups.subtitle: pg_dump backups, download and restore
backups.directoryDownloadHint: Directory format backups cannot be downloaded as one file; copy them from the server's backup directory.
backups.interrupted: Interrupted: the server stopped before this job finished.

confirm.restore: Backup #{id} will be restored into "{database}". It may conflict with existing objects. This is a DANGEROUS action.
confirm.restoreClean: Backup #{id} will be restored into "{database}". Existing objects are dropped first (CLEAN). This is a DANGEROUS action.

createDialog.title: Create a new backup
createDialog.description: Choose a format, compression and optionally a schema or table.
createDialog.warning: This needs MAINTENANCE confirmation and can increase server I/O.
createDialog.locationHint: Full folder path on the API server; leave empty for the default shown above. The folder is created if missing.
createDialog.schemasFailed: Could not load the schemas. Check that the database accepts connections.
createDialog.pickOne: Select at least one schema to back up.
createDialog.wholeDatabase: The whole database is backed up.
createDialog.partialHint: Only the selected schemas are backed up. Extensions and objects outside schemas are left out.

restore.title: Restore — DANGEROUS
restore.databaseHint: You will be asked to type this name again on the confirmation screen.
restore.cleanHint: Drops existing objects before restoring. Adds risk.
restore.cleanPlainHint: Not available for plain SQL backups.
restore.profileMismatch: This backup belongs to the "{profile}" profile. Select that profile before restoring it.
restore.warning: A restore can overwrite database objects and cause data loss. It needs DANGEROUS confirmation.

stats.failedHint: Error details appear in the list

list.title: Backup jobs
list.subtitle: {poll} · {count} jobs
list.emptyHint: Take the first one with "Create backup".

snapshots.title: Snapshots
snapshots.subtitle: History of health, connections, locks, queries and disk

toast.pruned: Prune finished: {removed} removed, last {days} days kept

confirm.capture: Records pg_stat_* views, health checks and connection data. This is a MAINTENANCE action with brief read I/O.
confirm.prune: Snapshots older than {days} days will be permanently deleted for ALL profiles. This cannot be undone.

list.title: Snapshot list
list.subtitle: {poll} · showing {shown} / {total}
list.emptyHint: Create the first one with "Take snapshot".

config.title: Server Configuration
config.subtitle: PostgreSQL parameters with guarded changes through ALTER SYSTEM SET
config.pendingRestartNotice: {count} settings need a server restart to take effect. A reload does not apply them.

confirm.changePostmaster: This setting ({context}) takes effect only after a PostgreSQL server restart.
confirm.changeSighup: This setting ({context}) is applied by pg_reload_conf(). Reload the configuration after this change.
confirm.changeOther: This setting ({context}) may take effect for new connections or sessions after a configuration reload.
confirm.reload: Calls pg_reload_conf(), which loads postgresql.conf and ALTER SYSTEM changes through SIGHUP. Running connections are not dropped. postmaster settings still need a restart.

list.title: Configuration settings
list.subtitle: Listing {shown} / {total} settings
